whyItMatters: A GitHub personal access token in source gives anyone with repository access the token's full scopes until it is revoked. This detection does not prove the token is live — treat it as exposed until proven otherwise.
actions: Revoke the token immediately in GitHub settings.
Audit what the token accessed (repository events, audit log) for the exposure window.
Replace it with a fine-grained token or GitHub App stored outside version control.
Purge the value from history where applicable and rotate anything it could reach.
verification: A fresh scan shows no DPK-SEC-002 finding and GitHub lists the token as revoked.
